title: Generic vs AI Challenge Card
description: The same repeat-block lesson, twice -- and the three fields customisation is allowed to touch.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: AI-Customized Curriculum and Rolling Out New Agents

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a generic and an AI-customized challenge card teaching the same concept, the learner compares them to identify what customization changed and what the required format kept constant.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Highlight what the customisation changed and what the format kept fixed; switch themes
pedagogical.assessment: Name which fields an AI customisation may change without breaking the set.
